capture_reconstruction.http_status_basis: The original capture wrote response bodies only after verifying HTTP status 200.

capture_reconstruction.retrieval_timestamp_basis: Per-file filesystem write timestamps in UTC; no response Date header is asserted.

scope: Official RBI T-bill notice/full-result pairs for 60 rows in Table 213 (2023-07-12 through 2024-08-28); table/notice issue-date conflicts retain both source values and use the contemporaneous auction notice for the normalized issue date; auction-yield levels only, not a calibrated risk history.
